import sys

def main():
    line = None
    while True:
        line = sys.stdin.readline()
        if not line:
            raise RuntimeError()
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            break
    s = line
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        if (j - i) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except RuntimeError:
        pass
